scope: All ordinary body-flow citation keys, the ten frozen nearby claims, exact primary-record metadata and passages, problem-origin and closest-prior comparisons, nontrivial method sources, user-library relevance, bibliography coverage, canonical BibTeX, AUX agreement, and final citation logs were checked against the current manuscript/PDF snapshot.
citation_audit_method: Two-stage citation-check protocol: first extract and freeze the complete claim/key ledger, then verify each fixed claim against the exact primary theorem, page, abstract, section, DOI/arXiv record, or locally archived official PDF; finish with bibliography-coverage review, canonical BibTeX/AUX comparison, and final log scans.
